scope: Shared result formatting and unattainable final-grade targets. Local production build; not deployed.
changes: At most two decimal places for ordinary result cards, worked examples, tables, numeric CSV cells and currency amounts. JPY retains zero fractional digits.
Small nonzero values use scientific notation with at most two mantissa decimals. Decimal-backed data conversions support exponents outside the Number range.
Engine-owned composite numeric answers opt into formatting; raw calculation values, user text and exact outputs are retained.

Final-grade and letter-grade target modes show a translated unattainable message above 100%, with the highest possible overall grade. Negative required scores show that the target is secured and the minimum score is zero.
The validated two-event probability model bounds floating-point excursions to zero through one. Growth, return, markup and similar ratios can still exceed 100%.
Decimal arithmetic defaults to two places; scientific arithmetic defaults to three significant digits. Users can explicitly select higher precision.
exceptions: User-selected rounding / random-decimal / scientific precision and high-precision arithmetic
Prescribed three-decimal Army recorded ratio and threshold
Dates, IP addresses and arbitrary user text

audit.otherModes: Currency-reference and global-currency modes use mocked quote snapshots in catalog tests. Road-route mode validates its missing-location default.

unitTests.coverage: Catalog-wide numeric presentation checks plus targeted grades, floating-point boundaries, numeric composites, tiny and huge quantities, localization, exact-output preservation and table immutability.
